name: Telegram Notifier
description: Delivers mail alerts to a Telegram chat via the Bot API
author: MailFlow community
readme:
## Telegram Notifier

Pushes processed mail alerts to a Telegram chat through the Bot API — create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather), get its token, and tell it your chat id. Urgency is included in the message so you can triage from your phone.

### Features

- Standard library only (urllib)
- Skips gracefully when credentials are missing (never breaks the pipeline)
- Urgency label + subject + summary in every message

### Usage

```toml
[[notifiers]]
notifier_id = "telegram"
provider = "telegram"
enabled = true
minimum_urgency = "important"
[notifiers.options]
bot_token = "${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}"   # from @BotFather
chat_id = "123456789"                 # your chat / group id
```

Get your chat id: send your bot any message, then call
`https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates` and read `message.chat.id`.

MIT — contributions welcome.

## mailflow-notify-telegram

通过 Bot API 把处理后的邮件提醒推送到 Telegram 会话——用 [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) 创建机器人拿到令牌，再告诉它你的会话 id。消息带紧急度标签，手机上即可分诊。

### 特性

- 仅用标准库（urllib）
- 凭据缺失时优雅跳过（绝不破坏流水线）
- 每条消息含紧急度标签 + 主题 + 摘要

### 配置

```toml
[[notifiers]]
notifier_id = "telegram"
provider = "telegram"
enabled = true
minimum_urgency = "important"
[notifiers.options]
bot_token = "${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}"   # 来自 @BotFather
chat_id = "123456789"                 # 你的会话/群组 id
```

获取会话 id：先给机器人随便发条消息，再访问
`https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates` 读取 `message.chat.id`。

### 协议

MIT — 欢迎贡献。
